title: BPS provincial GRDP (current prices) and population, Indonesia
format: CSV, UTF-8, comma-separated, one value per row; a missing row means BPS has no value

columns.province_code: BPS two-digit province code; 00 = Indonesia. Names in 'provinces'.
columns.sector: GRDP sector code (KBLI letter groups) or TOTAL; empty for population indicators.
columns.value: Number in the indicator's unit, as published by BPS (not rounded or rescaled).

sectors.E: Pengadaan Air, Pengelolaan Sampah, Limbah dan Daur Ulang
sectors.G: Perdagangan Besar dan Eceran, Reparasi Mobil dan Sepeda Motor
sectors.O: Administrasi Pemerintahan, Pertahanan dan Jaminan Sosial Wajib

grdp_current.name: PDRB atas dasar harga berlaku (GRDP at current prices), Seri 2010
grdp_current.periods: 2025Q1-2025Q4 and 2025 by sector; 2020-2024 annual TOTAL only
notes: 2025 values come from the BPS table '[Seri 2010] PDRB Triwulanan Atas Dasar Harga Berlaku Menurut Lapangan Usaha di Provinsi Seluruh Indonesia', last updated 5 Aug 2026.
2020-2024 annual totals come from the same BPS table for earlier years, compiled in raw/grdp-population/20261102_bps-province-grdp-population-2020-2025.xlsx.
Recent years (2024-2025 in particular) are likely preliminary and subject to revision.
BPS publishes no Indonesia row in this table; the sum of provincial GRDP is not national GDP, which BPS does not reconcile with it.
Sectors may differ from TOTAL, and quarters from the year, by up to 0.04 because of rounding in the BPS table.

population.name: Jumlah penduduk (population)
notes: 2021-2025 = Proyeksi Penduduk Indonesia 2020-2050 hasil SP2020, mid-year (June).
The 2025 table was last updated 2 May 2025.

population_growth.name: Laju pertumbuhan penduduk per tahun (annual population growth rate)
notes: Growth from the September 2020 census to the June 2025 projection; 2020 base population is the sum of the forming regencies and municipalities.

population_share.name: Distribusi persentase penduduk (share of national population)

population_density.name: Kepadatan penduduk (population density)
notes: Province area per Kepmendagri Nomor 100.1.1-6117 Tahun 2022 (9 November 2022).

Papua split: Papua Barat Daya (96), Papua Selatan (93), Papua Tengah (92) and Papua Pegunungan (95) have values from 2024. For 2020-2023, Papua (94) and Papua Barat (91) are the pre-split provinces and are not comparable with 2024-2025.
For a consistent series: Papua (old) = 94 + 93 + 92 + 95; Papua Barat (old) = 91 + 96.
GRDP per capita (Rp million per person) = grdp_current (Rp billion) / population (thousand); it is not stored because it is derived, and it may differ slightly from BPS's own PDRB per kapita.
bps_population_footnotes: 1Hasil Proyeksi Penduduk Indonesia 2020-2050 Hasil Sensus Penduduk 2020 (Pertengahan tahun/Juni)/ Indonesia Population Projection 2020-2050 Result of Population Census 2020 (mid year/June)

2Laju pertumbuhan penduduk dihitung berdasarkan penduduk tahun 2020 (September) dibandingkan dengan penduduk tahun 2025(Juni)/ The growth rate refers to the change of the population in 2020 (September) to the population in 2025 (June)

3Luas provinsi berdasarkan Keputusan Menteri Dalam Negeri Nomor 100.1.1-6117 Tahun 2022 tanggal 9 November 2022/ Province area Based on Ministerial Decree of Home Affairs Number 100.1.1-6117,9 November 2022

4 Laju pertumbuhan penduduk dihitung dengan menggunakan data dasar jumlah penduduk tahun 2020 yang merupakan penjumlahan dari kabupaten/kota pembentuk/ The Growth Rate calculated refers to total population 2020 is the sum of the forming regency/municipality
